description: The Canada Energy Regulator publishes the throughput and capacity that major regulated pipeline companies report at key points of their systems, and presents it in a flow and capacity dashboard. The dashboard page and the Open Government dataset read on 2026-09-28 describe quarterly filings under Guide BB of the Filing Manual since 2016, with monthly data for oil and liquids pipelines and daily data for natural gas pipelines, covering 2006 to the present. The dataset has one CSV per pipeline, including Keystone, Trans Mountain, Enbridge Mainline and Line 9, Cochin, NGTL, the TC Mainline, Alliance, Westcoast and Maritimes and Northeast, plus oil apportionment and data dictionaries; the CER calls it its most downloaded dataset, with DOI 10.35002/h579-7v23. Coverage is CER-regulated interprovincial and international pipelines. Access is free download under the Open Government Licence - Canada. Caveats: key points differ between pipelines, and Trans Mountain product categories changed in May 2024. It supports network flow and capacity studies, such as testing how an outage on one line shifts crude flows. Related record: the CER pipeline incident data give failures on the same systems.
